title: Serene close-up portrait video prompt (Veo/Sora)
prompt_text: Close-up portrait video of a young woman with blonde hair styled in an updo with loose strands framing her face, standing indoors near a staircase. She has flushed cheeks, delicate freckles, and a light sheen of sweat on her skin and collarbone, wearing a black top and cardigan with delicate gold layered necklaces. She takes slow, deep breaths with her eyes closed, exhaling calmly with a relaxed and peaceful expression. Soft indoor ambient lighting, shallow depth of field, photorealistic 8k resolution, serene and mindful mood.
